footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $31.0M income tax benefit. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The 10-K reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The company had an operating loss of $111M, versus operating income of $174M.

The company had a net loss of $80.0M, or −$0.81 per share, versus net income of $131M. Operating cash flow was $441M and free cash flow $441M, versus $459M; Navient returned $174M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Navient Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
